name: BIG HALF
notes: Official time from the race organisers is the finish time used throughout: it is the recorded result over the official distance, which is what the predictions were made for. The watch figures are close and change none of the comparisons: moving time is 13s slower than official, elapsed 22s slower, and there were no meaningful stops during the race. GPS distance exceeds official race distance by ~0.26km, typical GPS tangent-cutting error on a race with turns.
